history.reason: blocking smell "reflect-testlist-defect": reflection gate: T38/T39 assert an 'S2 add-index migration' (ix_stock_records_location_sku) but neither S2 AC nor the architecture declares such a migration: architecture.md/NFR1 state the only F1 migration is the initial create_table, and AP1 merely flags an index for a later DBA decision. The tests are mis-premised (a Driver would have to invent a migration or rewrite the shipped one). Either drop T38/T39, or have the architect declare the index migration (persistence invariant + AC note) first; row-survival (T39) then applies only to that additive migration.

blocking smell "reflect-architecture-defect": reflection gate: AC3 seeds an 'empty' location via a quantity-0 filing (OD3, still open), but that creates a stock_records row, so EP4 GET /api/stock/records?location= returns one row (qty 0), not an empty list. That contradicts AC1 ('one row per (sku, location) record') and makes stock-empty unreachable and T43/T44 unsatisfiable, unless zero-quantity rows are hidden, which no AC or note states. Resolve OD3 for this story: either EP4 excludes quantity-0 rows (and AC1 says so), or the empty state is defined as 'all rows at quantity 0'. Then align the AC3 notes and the T43/T44 seeding with that rule.
